name: Western Nepal 1-in-100 year flood (2)
description: Combined river and surface water flooding - western Nepal 1-in-100-year representative scenario.

vulnerability.source: JRC global flood depth-damage functions (Huizinga, De Moel and Szewczyk, 2017)
vulnerability.description: Damage by flood depth from the JRC global flood depth-damage functions for Asia, by occupancy class: residential, commercial, industrial, transport, infrastructure or agriculture (from the OED occupancy code). These are not JBA's own vulnerability functions; JBA provided the flood footprints.
